submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the newly drawn W sprite. Paint ONE new cast/W/06 frame. Images 2/3/4 are the authoritative portrait, W idle camera and approved painted game-art style. Preserve Image 1's exact head and face pixel size, proportions, full-canvas placement, pure screen-LEFT side view. Never mirror an E image. Do not zoom or fit bounding boxes.
Anatomy: exactly two shoulders, two arms, two sleeve openings and two hands. Camera-near anatomical LEFT hand grips bronze bell with red tassel. Far anatomical RIGHT hand grips fan of EXACTLY FIVE separate red rectangular talisman cards, their five rectangular top edges clearly countable. Continuous sleeve-wrist-hand connection, no third sleeve. Do not swap props.
THIS FRAME POSE: Release begins. Starting from the EDIT TARGET's coiled pose, far RIGHT elbow opens halfway: send the same five-card fan forward toward screen-left, hand now a little below eye height and visibly separated from face, right elbow still bent about70degrees. EXACTLY SAME FIVE PANELS remain one fan, do not add edge slivers. Near LEFT bell stays raised around shoulder at screen-right, wrist turning the bell mouth down. Weight starts transferring to front screen-left bent knee, rear leg extends slightly, both shoes firmly separate. Torso inclines screen-left about5degrees, focused slightly open mouth. Maintain the same head size and canvas position apart from this physical shift. This is the first forward thrust, not maximum straight-arm release.
Preserve the chestnut high ponytail, jewel crown, flame-pattern red/gold short robe, black trousers, yin-yang waist ornament, red/black/gold shoes, youthful face and rounded clean richly painted Taoist chibi style. The body can naturally rise/fall a little while bending knees; the head and all props keep identical pixel dimensions. Ground virtual y920 and root x512 at1024. No automatic per-frame resizing. Keep both hands and feet separated and readable.
Single native square frame at least1024x1024 with genuine transparent RGBA, no scenery, shadows, light effects, detached flames, particles, text or labels. No contact sheet, only this single pose.
